significance: A Shiva temple on the Thanjavur-Kumbakonam road whose lingam is called Kiruthivakesvarar and whose goddess is Alankaravalli. It is counted among the shrines associated with the Nayanar saint Appar.
story: Shiva is said to have taken this name after killing the asura Kayasuran who was tormenting the people, and Parvati is held to have performed penance at the site.
